title: SMUK SKAK GM 2026 in Skanderborg
excerpt: From losing my very first game to winning the tournament — and a final round I will certainly never forget.
lead: Winning the Smuk Skak GM Tournament in Skanderborg for the second year in a row was a very special result for me — especially considering how the tournament started.
body: In the very first round, I lost to Nikola Kanov from Bulgaria, putting myself under pressure right from the beginning.

What followed was a great comeback. I managed to recover quickly, win several important games, and work my way back to the top of the standings. With each round, my confidence grew, and suddenly I found myself fighting for first place again. My personal highlight was the game in Round 3.

[game:gmtua19khyeo6]
The final round was absolutely crazy. I had a chance to secure a GM norm, but after a long and extremely complicated game against Gergely Aczel, I reached a point where I honestly thought I was going to lose and was ready to give up. Then, completely unexpectedly, I got one more chance. I managed to turn the game around and fight my way back into it — only for the game to eventually end in a draw.

Missing the norm was obviously disappointing, but after the way the tournament had started, winning the tournament outright with 6½/9 made the result all the more satisfying. **To go from losing my first game to coming back and winning the tournament for the second year in a row made this one particularly memorable.**

title.en: A Beautiful win in a reversed benoni.
